description: Datendownload - Abwasser NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Download the data containing "Wastewater content (cumulative) in water from municipal wastewater treatment plants in NRW (2020)", "Municipal wastewater - municipal wastewater treatment plants NRW" and "Industrial wastewater NRW - direct / indirect initiating plants, wastewater treatment plants" as atomic feed. Coverage: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The portal shows the English title as "Data download - Wastewater NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Its keywords include Atom-Feed, LANUK-Feed, Atom Feed. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ATOM. The listing shows 2026-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
